final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.ID, step1.cnt, CAST(step1.cnt AS REAL) / step2.total as ratio FROM step1, step2 WHERE step2.total IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3), final_result AS (SELECT step3.ID, step3.cnt, step3.ratio, step3.ratio - step4.avg_ratio as diff FROM step3, step4 WHERE step4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND step3.ratio > step4.avg_ratio ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT ID, cnt, ratio, diff FROM final_result
